ritualReleaseContract.policy: Three required shield-opening stages in encounter (creator B), plus one final controlled release Action. Existing prior one-action 2B is interpreted as the *finishing* action, not bypass of shield puzzle.

stages.effect: separate control threads but hostage tethers persist
outer binding shield opens; attack damage now permitted

ritualReleaseContract.finalAction: A single player-controlled actual Action at reachable bracelet, after stage3, that resolves successful controlled release by existing Core/Combat. ritual stopped and all tether=false; Kaew HP0 neither needed nor sufficient.
ritualReleaseContract.combatRequirement: Final Combat Lite session and meaningful player Action window must open before success from an active|weakened binding; no auto-hit/harm.
ritualReleaseContract.stepResolution: Existing Core/Combat Action validity; no new DC/AP rolls. No access/class hard gate, no fixed rounds, no resetting successful progress on a failed action.
ritualReleaseContract.attackPolicy: Boss shield up means zero damage to Kaew HP/Sanity from all damage-type attacks; native attack hit/costs still resolved. Non-damage effects resolved per native rules. After step3 normal attacks apply.
ritualReleaseContract.preExistingStopped: if valid ritual stopped before E6, skip forced return/combat/shield; go F5
ritualReleaseContract.failForward: Unknown E4 plan still learns visible anchor/thread/knot cues in Final, can use legitimate actions and old D2 clues; never a dead end due to missed rolls.
